name: Coorg
description: Coorg (Kodagu), often called the Scotland of India, is a misty hill region of coffee and spice plantations, waterfalls and rolling hills. Madikeri is its main town and the base for exploring the district.
history: Kodagu was ruled by the Haleri kings from the 17th century until the British annexed it in 1834. The Kodava people are known for their martial traditions, unique cuisine and the festivals of Kailpodh and Puthari.
how_to_reach: Madikeri is 260 km from Bengaluru (5.5 hours) via Mysuru. KSRTC runs Airavat buses; the nearest railway station is Mysuru (120 km).
tips: Stay at a plantation homestay for the best Kodava food. Monsoon (June-Sept) is beautiful but very wet and leech-prone.
summary_kn: ಭಾರತದ ಸ್ಕಾಟ್ಲೆಂಡ್ ಎಂದೇ ಕರೆಯುವ ಕೊಡಗು ಕಾಫಿ ತೋಟಗಳು, ಜಲಪಾತಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮಂಜು ಮುಸುಕಿದ ಬೆಟ್ಟಗಳ ನಾಡು.
summary_hi: भारत का स्कॉटलैंड कहलाने वाला कूर्ग कॉफ़ी बागानों, झरनों और धुंध भरी पहाड़ियों का क्षेत्र है।

name: Chikmagalur
description: Chikmagalur is the birthplace of Indian coffee, surrounded by the Baba Budangiri range, Mullayanagiri peak and endless coffee estates. It is a favourite weekend getaway for trekking and plantation stays.
history: Legend says the Sufi saint Baba Budan smuggled seven coffee beans from Yemen in the 17th century and planted them in these hills, starting coffee cultivation in India.
how_to_reach: Chikmagalur is 245 km from Bengaluru (5 hours). Kadur (40 km) and Birur are the nearest railway stations; regular buses connect Bengaluru.
tips: Hire a jeep to reach Jhari Falls and Baba Budangiri; roads get foggy after 4 PM.
summary_kn: ಭಾರತದ ಕಾಫಿಯ ಜನ್ಮಸ್ಥಳ ಚಿಕ್ಕಮಗಳೂರು ಮುಳ್ಳಯ್ಯನಗಿರಿ, ಬಾಬಾಬುಡನ್‌ಗಿರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಫಿ ತೋಟಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ.
summary_hi: भारतीय कॉफ़ी की जन्मभूमि चिकमगलूर मुल्लायनगिरी, बाबा बुदनगिरी और कॉफ़ी बागानों के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

name: Kudremukh
description: Kudremukh, meaning 'horse face', is a peak and national park in the Western Ghats known for rolling shola grasslands and one of the most scenic treks in South India.
history: The area was once home to a large iron-ore mine that closed in 2006 after environmental campaigns. The national park protects the source of the Tunga, Bhadra and Netravati rivers.
how_to_reach: Kudremukh is 330 km from Bengaluru and 100 km from Chikkamagaluru town; the trek starts from Mullodi village.
tips: The trek requires a forest department permit booked online; it is about 20 km round trip, so start early.
summary_kn: ಕುದುರೆಮುಖ ಶೋಲಾ ಹುಲ್ಲುಗಾವಲುಗಳ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಉದ್ಯಾನ ಮತ್ತು ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಭಾರತದ ಸುಂದರ ಚಾರಣ ಮಾರ್ಗ.
summary_hi: कुद्रेमुख शोला घास के मैदानों वाला राष्ट्रीय उद्यान और दक्षिण भारत का सुंदर ट्रेक है।

name: Nandi Hills
description: Nandi Hills is an ancient hill fortress 60 km from Bengaluru, famous for sunrise views above a sea of clouds, cycling routes and Tipu Sultan's summer retreat.
history: The hill was fortified by Tipu Sultan, and the steep cliff called Tipu's Drop was reportedly used to execute prisoners. The Bhoga Nandeeshwara Temple at the foothills dates to the 9th century.
how_to_reach: Nandi Hills is 60 km (1.5 hours) from Bengaluru city, close to the airport. Self-drive or cab is the easiest option.
tips: Gates open at 6 AM; on weekends leave Bengaluru by 4:30 AM to catch the sunrise.
summary_kn: ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನಿಂದ 60 ಕಿ.ಮೀ ದೂರದ ನಂದಿ ಬೆಟ್ಟ ಮೋಡಗಳ ಮೇಲಿನ ಸೂರ್ಯೋದಯಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ.
summary_hi: बेंगलुरु से 60 किमी दूर नंदी हिल्स बादलों के ऊपर सूर्योदय के नज़ारे के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

name: Agumbe
description: Agumbe is a small village in the Western Ghats known as the Cherrapunji of the South for its heavy rainfall. It is famous for its sunset point, rainforests and as the home of the King Cobra research station.
history: Agumbe became nationally known as the shooting location of the TV series Malgudi Days in the 1980s. The Agumbe Rainforest Research Station was founded by herpetologist Romulus Whitaker in 2005.
how_to_reach: Agumbe is 95 km from Shivamogga and 55 km from Udupi via the hairpin Agumbe Ghat. Buses run from Shivamogga and Udupi.
tips: Carry leech socks in the monsoon. The sunset point is best on clear winter evenings.
summary_kn: ದಕ್ಷಿಣದ ಚಿರಾಪುಂಜಿ ಎನಿಸಿದ ಆಗುಂಬೆ ಮಳೆಕಾಡು, ಸೂರ್ಯಾಸ್ತ ಸ್ಥಳ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಳಿಂಗ ಸರ್ಪಗಳಿಗೆ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿ.
summary_hi: दक्षिण का चेरापूंजी कहलाने वाला आगुम्बे वर्षावन, सूर्यास्त बिंदु और किंग कोबरा के लिए जाना जाता है।

name: Sakleshpur
description: Sakleshpur is a quiet hill town in the Western Ghats with coffee, cardamom and pepper estates, the star-shaped Manjarabad Fort and green trekking trails such as Bisle Ghat.
history: Manjarabad Fort was built by Tipu Sultan in 1792 in the shape of an eight-pointed star, following French military design.
how_to_reach: Sakleshpur is 220 km from Bengaluru on the Bengaluru - Mangaluru highway and has a railway station.
tips: The Bisle Ghat road is narrow and slippery in the monsoon; prefer daytime driving.
summary_kn: ಪಶ್ಚಿಮ ಘಟ್ಟಗಳ ಸಕಲೇಶಪುರ ಕಾಫಿ ತೋಟಗಳು, ನಕ್ಷತ್ರಾಕಾರದ ಮಂಜರಾಬಾದ್ ಕೋಟೆ ಮತ್ತು ಚಾರಣಗಳಿಗೆ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿ.
summary_hi: पश्चिमी घाट का सकलेशपुर कॉफ़ी बागानों, तारे के आकार के मंजराबाद किले और ट्रेकिंग के लिए जाना जाता है।

name: BR Hills
description: Biligiriranga Hills (BR Hills) form a tiger reserve linking the Western and Eastern Ghats, with the Biligiri Ranganatha Temple on top and jeep safaris through dense forests.
history: The hills are home to the Soliga tribal community, who were among the first forest dwellers in India to have their rights recognised inside a tiger reserve (2011).
timings: Safari 6:30 AM - 9:00 AM and 3:30 PM - 6:00 PM
how_to_reach: BR Hills is 180 km from Bengaluru and 90 km from Mysuru via Yelandur.
tips: Book the Jungle Lodges K Gudi camp for the best chance of wildlife sightings.
summary_kn: ಪಶ್ಚಿಮ ಮತ್ತು ಪೂರ್ವ ಘಟ್ಟಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸುವ ಬಿಳಿಗಿರಿರಂಗನ ಬೆಟ್ಟ ಹುಲಿ ಸಂರಕ್ಷಿತ ಪ್ರದೇಶ ಮತ್ತು ರಂಗನಾಥ ದೇವಾಲಯಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ.
summary_hi: पश्चिमी और पूर्वी घाटों को जोड़ने वाली बीआर हिल्स बाघ अभयारण्य और रंगनाथ मंदिर के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

name: Kemmangundi
description: Kemmangundi is a peaceful hill station in the Baba Budan range, known for its ornamental gardens, the Z Point viewpoint and the nearby Hebbe and Kallathigiri falls.
history: Kemmangundi was the summer retreat of Krishnaraja Wadiyar IV, who developed the Raj Bhavan gardens here in the early 20th century.
how_to_reach: Kemmangundi is 55 km from Chikkamagaluru town and 270 km from Bengaluru. Birur is the nearest railway station.
tips: The walk to Z Point takes about 45 minutes one way through shola forest - go in the morning.
summary_kn: ಬಾಬಾಬುಡನ್ ಶ್ರೇಣಿಯ ಕೆಮ್ಮಣ್ಣುಗುಂಡಿ ಉದ್ಯಾನಗಳು, Z ಪಾಯಿಂಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ಹತ್ತಿರದ ಜಲಪಾತಗಳಿಗೆ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿ.
summary_hi: बाबा बुदन श्रेणी का केम्मनगुंडी बगीचों, ज़ेड पॉइंट और पास के झरनों के लिए जाना जाता है।

name: Mullayanagiri
description: Mullayanagiri is the highest peak in Karnataka at 1,930 m. A short climb of about 450 steps from the road end leads to a small temple and sweeping views of the Chandra Drona hills.
history: The peak is named after Mullappa Swamy, a sage who is believed to have meditated in a cave near the summit, where a small temple now stands.
how_to_reach: Mullayanagiri is 20 km from Chikkamagaluru town. Private vehicles are restricted on weekends - use the shuttle service.
tips: It is very windy at the top; carry a jacket even in summer.
summary_kn: 1,930 ಮೀ ಎತ್ತರದ ಮುಳ್ಳಯ್ಯನಗಿರಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಅತಿ ಎತ್ತರದ ಶಿಖರ; ಸೂರ್ಯೋದಯ ಮತ್ತು ಚಾರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಸೂಕ್ತ.
summary_hi: 1,930 मीटर ऊँचा मुल्लायनगिरी कर्नाटक की सबसे ऊँची चोटी है; सूर्योदय और ट्रेकिंग के लिए आदर्श।

name: Kodachadri
description: Kodachadri is a 1,343 m peak in the Western Ghats known for dramatic sunsets, dense forests, the Hidlumane waterfall trek and a small shrine where Adi Shankaracharya is believed to have meditated.
history: The peak is closely tied to the Kollur Mookambika legend; the Sarvajna Peetha at the summit marks the spot of Shankaracharya's meditation.
how_to_reach: Kodachadri is 20 km from Kollur. Shared jeeps from Kollur take you most of the way; trekkers start from Hidlumane.
tips: Jeep tracks are rough; carry motion-sickness tablets if needed.
summary_kn: ಕೊಡಚಾದ್ರಿ ಪಶ್ಚಿಮ ಘಟ್ಟದ ಸುಂದರ ಶಿಖರ; ಸೂರ್ಯಾಸ್ತ, ದಟ್ಟ ಕಾಡು ಮತ್ತು ಸರ್ವಜ್ಞ ಪೀಠಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿ.
summary_hi: कोडाचाद्री पश्चिमी घाट की सुंदर चोटी है जो सूर्यास्त, घने जंगल और सर्वज्ञ पीठ के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

name: Jog Falls
description: Jog Falls is one of the highest plunge waterfalls in India, where the Sharavathi river drops 253 m in four distinct streams named Raja, Rani, Rover and Rocket.
history: The falls have attracted travellers for centuries; the Linganamakki Dam upstream, built in 1964, now regulates the flow, so the falls are at their fullest during the monsoon.
how_to_reach: Jog Falls is 105 km from Shivamogga and 400 km from Bengaluru. Talaguppa railway station is 16 km away; buses run from Sagara.
tips: Visit between July and October for full flow. The steps to the base can close during heavy rain.
summary_kn: ಶರಾವತಿ ನದಿ 253 ಮೀ ಎತ್ತರದಿಂದ ರಾಜ, ರಾಣಿ, ರೋರರ್, ರಾಕೆಟ್ ಎಂಬ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಧಾರೆಗಳಾಗಿ ಧುಮುಕುವ ಜೋಗ ಜಲಪಾತ ಭಾರತದ ಎತ್ತರದ ಜಲಪಾತಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು.
summary_hi: जोग फॉल्स भारत के सबसे ऊँचे झरनों में से एक है, जहाँ शरावती नदी 253 मीटर से चार धाराओं में गिरती है।

name: Abbey Falls
description: Abbey Falls is a picturesque waterfall near Madikeri, reached by a short walk through coffee and spice plantations to a hanging bridge facing the falls.
history: During British rule the falls were named Jessy Falls after the daughter of Madikeri's first chaplain; locals call it Abbi, meaning waterfall in Kodava.
how_to_reach: Abbey Falls is 8 km from Madikeri town; taxis and autos are available.
tips: Swimming is not allowed. Expect about 150 steps on the path down.
summary_kn: ಮಡಿಕೇರಿ ಸಮೀಪದ ಅಬ್ಬಿ ಜಲಪಾತ ಕಾಫಿ ತೋಟಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ನಡಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ತೂಗು ಸೇತುವೆಗೆ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿ.
summary_hi: मडिकेरी के पास एबी फॉल्स कॉफ़ी बागानों के बीच पैदल रास्ते और झूलते पुल के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

name: Shivanasamudra Falls
description: At Shivanasamudra the Kaveri river splits into the twin falls of Gaganachukki and Bharachukki, a wide, thundering spectacle best seen during the monsoon.
history: Asia's first hydroelectric power station was commissioned here in 1902, supplying electricity to the Kolar Gold Fields and later to Bengaluru, one of the first lit cities in India.
how_to_reach: Shivanasamudra is 135 km from Bengaluru via Malavalli and 80 km from Mysuru.
tips: Coracle rides at Bharachukki operate only when the water level is safe.
summary_kn: ಕಾವೇರಿ ನದಿ ಗಗನಚುಕ್ಕಿ ಮತ್ತು ಭರಚುಕ್ಕಿ ಎಂಬ ಅವಳಿ ಜಲಪಾತಗಳಾಗಿ ಧುಮುಕುವ ಶಿವನಸಮುದ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಏಷ್ಯಾದ ಮೊದಲ ಜಲವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಕೇಂದ್ರವಿದೆ.
summary_hi: शिवनसमुद्र में कावेरी नदी गगनचुक्की और भरचुक्की जुड़वाँ झरनों में गिरती है; यहाँ एशिया का पहला जलविद्युत केंद्र है।

name: Gokak Falls
description: Gokak Falls is a horseshoe-shaped waterfall on the Ghataprabha river, 52 m high, often compared to Niagara for its shape. A 200 m hanging bridge spans the gorge.
history: One of the first hydroelectric plants in India was set up here in 1887 to power the Gokak textile mills.
how_to_reach: Gokak Falls is 60 km from Belagavi and 6 km from Gokak town; Gokak Road is the nearest railway station.
tips: Try Gokak's famous karadantu (dry-fruit sweet) before leaving town.
summary_kn: ಘಟಪ್ರಭಾ ನದಿಯ ಕುದುರೆಲಾಳಾಕಾರದ ಗೋಕಾಕ ಜಲಪಾತ ಮತ್ತು ತೂಗು ಸೇತುವೆ ಉತ್ತರ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಆಕರ್ಷಣೆ.
summary_hi: घटप्रभा नदी पर घोड़े की नाल के आकार का गोकाक झरना और झूलता पुल उत्तर कर्नाटक का मुख्य आकर्षण है।

name: Hebbe Falls
description: Hebbe Falls cascades 168 m in two stages (Dodda Hebbe and Chikka Hebbe) inside a coffee estate near Kemmangundi, reached by a bumpy jeep ride and a short walk across streams.
history: The falls lie inside private coffee estates and the Bhadra wildlife area; access is managed by the forest department and estate jeep operators.
how_to_reach: Reach Kemmangundi, then take a shared jeep (about 8 km) to the falls trail.
tips: The jeep ride costs extra (shared, per jeep). Wear shoes that can get wet.
summary_kn: ಕೆಮ್ಮಣ್ಣುಗುಂಡಿ ಸಮೀಪ ಕಾಫಿ ತೋಟದೊಳಗೆ 168 ಮೀ ಎತ್ತರದಿಂದ ಧುಮುಕುವ ಹೆಬ್ಬೆ ಜಲಪಾತಕ್ಕೆ ಜೀಪ್ ಸವಾರಿ ಮೂಲಕ ತಲುಪಬಹುದು.
summary_hi: केम्मनगुंडी के पास कॉफ़ी बागान में 168 मीटर से गिरता हेब्बे फॉल्स जीप की सवारी से पहुँचा जाता है।

name: Iruppu Falls
description: Iruppu Falls is a freshwater cascade in the Brahmagiri range of south Kodagu, near the Rameshwara Temple and on the edge of Nagarhole forest.
history: Legend says Lakshmana shot an arrow into the Brahmagiri hills to bring water for Rama, creating the Lakshmana Tirtha river that forms the falls. Pilgrims bathe here during Shivaratri.
how_to_reach: Iruppu is 48 km from Gonikoppal and about 90 km from Madikeri.
tips: A 1 km forest walk leads to the falls; combine with a Nagarhole safari.
summary_kn: ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಕೊಡಗಿನ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಗಿರಿ ಶ್ರೇಣಿಯ ಇರ್ಪು ಜಲಪಾತ ರಾಮೇಶ್ವರ ದೇವಾಲಯದ ಸಮೀಪದಲ್ಲಿದೆ.
summary_hi: दक्षिण कोडागु की ब्रह्मगिरी श्रेणी में इरुप्पु झरना रामेश्वर मंदिर के पास स्थित है।

name: Sathodi Falls
description: Sathodi Falls, nicknamed the mini Niagara of Karnataka, is a wide 15 m cascade in thick forests near Yellapur, ending in a calm pool at the backwaters of the Kodasalli dam.
history: The falls are formed by several streams joining together - the name refers to seven streams meeting before the drop.
how_to_reach: Sathodi is 32 km from Yellapur; the last 2 km is a forest trail. Hubballi (100 km) is the nearest major city.
tips: Swimming in the pool is risky after heavy rain - follow forest guard instructions.
summary_kn: ಯಲ್ಲಾಪುರ ಬಳಿಯ ಸಾತೊಡ್ಡಿ ಜಲಪಾತವನ್ನು ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಮಿನಿ ನಯಾಗರಾ ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary_hi: येल्लापुर के पास सातोड्डी फॉल्स को कर्नाटक का मिनी नियाग्रा कहा जाता है।

name: Unchalli Falls
description: Unchalli Falls, also known as Lushington Falls, drops 116 m on the Aghanashini river amid dense evergreen forest near Sirsi. Its roar gives it the local name Keppa Joga.
history: It was 'discovered' for British records in 1845 by J.D. Lushington, a district collector, after whom it was named.
how_to_reach: Unchalli is 35 km from Sirsi; Sirsi is 400 km from Bengaluru and 100 km from Hubballi.
tips: About 300 steps lead down to the viewing deck; combine with Sahasralinga and Yana.
summary_kn: ಶಿರಸಿ ಸಮೀಪದ ಅಘನಾಶಿನಿ ನದಿಯ ಉಂಚಳ್ಳಿ ಜಲಪಾತ 116 ಮೀ ಎತ್ತರದಿಂದ ದಟ್ಟ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಧುಮುಕುತ್ತದೆ.
summary_hi: सिरसी के पास अघनाशिनी नदी पर उंचल्ली फॉल्स घने जंगल में 116 मीटर से गिरता है।
